74714.commentary: (NIDD2) saṅghaṭṭayantāni duve bhujasmin'ti bhujo vuccati hattho. yathā ekasmiṃ hatthe dve nūpurāni ghaṭṭenti, evam'eva sattā taṇhāvasena diṭṭhivasena niraye ghaṭṭenti, tiracchānayoniyaṃ ghaṭṭenti, pettivisaye ghaṭṭenti, manussaloke ghaṭṭenti, devaloke ghaṭṭenti, gatiyā gatiṃ upapattiyā upapattiṃ paṭisandhiyā paṭisandhiṃ bhavena bhavaṃ saṃsārena saṃsāraṃ vaṭṭena vaṭṭaṃ ghaṭṭenti saṅghaṭṭenti saṅghaṭṭentā caranti viharanti iriyanti vattenti pālenti yapenti yāpentī'ti, saṅghaṭṭayantāni duve bhujasmiṃ, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

examples.text: disvā suvaṇṇassa pabhassarāni, kammāraputtena suniṭṭhitāni, saṅghaṭṭayantāni duve bhujasmiṃ, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

74715.commentary: (NIDD2) vāc'ābhilāpo abhisajjanā vā'ti vāc'ābhilāpo vuccati bāttiṃsa tiracchānakathā, seyyath'idaṃ, rājakathaṃ… itibhav'ābhavakathaṃ.

examples.text: evaṃ dutiyena sahā mam'assa, vāc'ābhilāpo abhisajjanā vā, etaṃ bhayaṃ āyatiṃ pekkhamāno, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

74716.meaning1: horseflies and snakes; gadflies and creepy crawlies
74716.commentary: (JAa) ḍaṃsa-sarīsape cā'ti ḍaṃsā vuccanti piṅgalamakkhikā, sabbā'pi vā makkhikājātikā idha ḍaṃsā'ti adhippetā. sarīsapā'ti dīghajātikā. ḍaṃsā ca sarīsapā ca ḍaṃsa-sarīsapā, tasmiṃ ḍaṃsa-sarīsape sati.

examples.text: sītañ'ca uṇhañ'ca khudaṃ pipāsaṃ, vāt'ātape ḍaṃsasiriṃsape ca, sabbāni'p'etāni abhisambhavitvā, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

74718.meaning1: having avoided; having shunned; having eschewed; having steered clear (of)
74718.commentary: (NIDD2) nāgo'va yūthāni vivajjayitvā'ti yathā so hatthināgo yūthāni vivajjetvā parivajjetvā abhinivajjetvā eko'va araññavanamajjh'ogāhetvā carati viharati iriyati vatteti pāleti yapeti yāpeti, paccekasambuddho'pi gaṇaṃ vivajjetvā parivajjetvā abhivajjetvā eko araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevati appasaddāni appanigghosāni vijanavātāni manussarāhasseyyakāni paṭisallānasāruppāni. so eko gacchati eko tiṭṭhati eko nisīdati eko seyyaṃ kappeti eko gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pavisati eko paṭikkamati eko raho nisīdati eko caṅkamaṃ adhiṭṭhāti eko carati viharati iriyati vatteti pāleti yapeti yāpetī'ti, nāgo'va yūthāni vivajjayitvā.

examples.text: nāgo'va yūthāni vivajjayitvā, sañjātakhandho padumī uḷāro, yath'ābhirantaṃ viharaṃ araññe, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

74719.meaning1: fully-grown; well-developed; well built; with a massive bulk
74719.commentary: (NIDD2) sañjātakhandho padumī uḷāro'ti yathā so hatthināgo sañjātakkhandho sattaratano vā hoti aṭṭharatano vā, paccekasambuddho'pi sañjātakkhandho asekkhena sīlakkhandhena asekkhena samādhikkhandhena asekkhena paññākkhandhena asekkhena vimuttikkhandhena asekkhena vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandhena. (JAa) sañjātakhandhassā'ti susaṇṭhitamahākhandhassa.

examples.text: nāgo'va yūthāni vivajjayitvā, sañjātakhandho padumī uḷāro, yath'ābhirantaṃ viharaṃ araññe, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

(SNPa) uppannañāṇo'mhī'ti uppannapaccekabodhiñāṇo amhi. etena phalaṃ dasseti.

examples.text: diṭṭhīvisūkāni upātivatto, patto niyāmaṃ paṭiladdhamaggo, uppannañāṇo'mhi anaññaneyyo, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

examples.text: ohārayitvā gihibyañjanāni, sañchannapatto yathā pārichatto, kāsāyavattho abhinikkhamitvā, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

74744.commentary: (NIDD2) sañchannapatto yathā pārichattako'ti yathā so pārichattako koviḷāro bahalapattapalāso sandacchāyo, evam'eva so paccekasambuddho paripuṇṇapattacīvaradharo'ti, sañchannapatto yathā pārichattako.

examples.text: ohārayitvā gihibyañjanāni, sañchannapatto yathā pārichatto, kāsāyavattho abhinikkhamitvā, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

74745.commentary: (NIDD2) sañchannapatto yathā pārichattako'ti yathā so pārichattako koviḷāro bahalapattapalāso sandacchāyo, evam'eva so paccekasambuddho paripuṇṇapattacīvaradharo'ti, sañchannapatto yathā pārichattako.

examples.text: ohārayitvā gihibyañjanāni, sañchannapatto yathā pārichatto, kāsāyavattho abhinikkhamitvā, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

74746.meaning1: having retired from the world; having renounced the household life; having ordained
74746.commentary: (NIDD2) kāsāyavattho abhinikkhamitvā'ti so paccekasambuddho sabbaṃ ghar'āvāsapalibodhaṃ chinditvā puttadāraṃ palibodhaṃ chinditvā ñātipalibodhaṃ chinditvā mitt'āmaccapalibodhaṃ chinditvā sannidhipalibodhaṃ chinditvā kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitvā akiñcanabhāvaṃ upagantvā eko carati viharati iriyati vatteti pāleti yapeti yāpetī'ti, kāsāyavattho abhinikkhamitvā, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. (SNPa) kāsāyavattho abhinikkhamitvā'ti imassa pādassa gehā abhinikkhamitvā kāsāyavattho hutvā'ti evam'attho veditabbo.

examples.text: ohārayitvā gihibyañjanāni, sañchannapatto yathā pārichatto, kāsāyavattho abhinikkhamitvā, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

74747.meaning1: five obstructions; five obstacles; five impediments
74747.commentary: (NIDD2) pahāya pañc'āvaraṇāni cetaso'ti so paccekasambuddho kāmacchandanīvaraṇaṃ pahāya pajahitvā vinodetvā byantīkaritvā anabhāvaṃ gametvā, byāpādanīvaraṇaṃ… thinamiddhanīvaraṇaṃ… uddhaccakukkuccanīvaraṇaṃ… vicikicchānīvaraṇaṃ pahāya pajahitvā vinodetvā byantīkaritvā anabhāvaṃ gametvā vivicc'eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharatī'ti, pahāya pañc'āvaraṇāni cetaso.

examples.text: pahāya pañc'āvaraṇāni cetaso, upakkilese byapanujja sabbe, anissito chetva sinehadosaṃ, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

74748.commentary: (NIDD2) upakkilese byapanujja sabbe'ti sabbe cittassa upakkilese byapanujja panuditvā pajahitvā vinodetvā byantīkaritvā anabhāvaṃ gametvā'ti, upakkilese byapanujja sabbe. (SNPa) byapanujjā'ti panuditvā vināsetvā, vipassanāmaggena pajahitvā'ti attho.

examples.text: pahāya pañc'āvaraṇāni cetaso, upakkilese byapanujja sabbe, anissito chetva sinehadosaṃ, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

74749.meaning1: love and hate; affection and aversion
74749.commentary: (NIDD2) anissito chetva sinehadosan'ti so paccekasambuddho taṇhāsnehañ'ca diṭṭhisnehañ'ca dosañ'ca chetvā

examples.text: pahāya pañc'āvaraṇāni cetaso, upakkilese byapanujja sabbe, anissito chetva sinehadosaṃ, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

74750.meaning1: love and hate; desire and aversion
74750.commentary: (NIDD2) anissito chetva sinehadosan'ti so paccekasambuddho taṇhāsnehañ'ca diṭṭhisnehañ'ca dosañ'ca chetvā (SNPa) sesamaggehi chetvā tedhātukaṃ sinehadosaṃ, taṇhārāgan'ti vuttaṃ hoti. sineho eva hi guṇapaṭipakkhato sinehadoso'ti vutto.

examples.text: pahāya pañc'āvaraṇāni cetaso, upakkilese byapanujja sabbe, anissito chetva snehadosaṃ, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

74751.meaning1: having turned one's back on; having abandoned; having left behind
74751.commentary: (NIDD2) vipiṭṭhikatvāna sukhaṃ dukhañ'ca, pubb'eva ca somanassadomanassan'ti so paccekasambuddho sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubb'eva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamā adukkham'asukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharatī'ti, vipiṭṭhikatvāna sukhaṃ dukhañ'ca, pubb'eva ca somanassadomanassaṃ. (SNPa) vipiṭṭhikatvānā'ti piṭṭhito katvā, chaḍḍetvā jahitvā'ti attho.

examples.text: vipiṭṭhikatvāna sukhaṃ dukhañ'ca, pubb'eva ca somanassadomanassaṃ, laddhān'upekkhaṃ samathaṃ visuddhaṃ, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

74752.meaning1: having obtained mental poise; having attained equanimity
74752.commentary: (NIDD2) laddhān'upekkhaṃ samathaṃ visuddhan'ti catutthajjhānaṃ upekkhañ'ca samathañ'ca laddhā labhitvā vinditvā paṭilabhitvā'ti, laddhān'upekkhaṃ samathaṃ visuddhaṃ, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

examples.text: vipiṭṭhikatvāna sukhaṃ dukhañ'ca, pubb'eva ca somanassadomanassaṃ, laddhān'upekkhaṃ samathaṃ visuddhaṃ, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

74753.meaning1: reaching the ultimate goal; attainment of the highest truth; achieving the ultimate state
74753.commentary: (NIDD2) āraddhavīriyo param'atthapattiyā'ti param'atthaṃ vuccati amataṃ nibbānaṃ. yo so sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ. param'atthassa pattiyā lābhāya paṭilābhāya adhigamāya phassanāya sacchikiriyāya āraddhavīriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ sampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesū'ti, āraddhavīriyo param'atthapattiyā. (SNPa) param'attho vuccati nibbānaṃ, tassa pattiyā param'atthapattiyā. etena vīriy'ārambhena pattabbaphalaṃ dasseti.

examples.text: āraddhavīriyo param'atthapattiyā, alīnacitto akusītavutti, daḷhanikkamo thāmabal'ūpapanno, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

74754.commentary: (NIDD2) alīnacitto akusītavuttī'ti so paccekasambuddho anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati, uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya… anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya… uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati vīriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahatī'ti, evaṃ alīnacitto akusītavutti. (SNPa) akusītavuttī'ti etena ṭhāna-āsana-caṅkaman'ādīsu kāyassa anavasīdanaṃ.

examples.text: āraddhavīriyo param'atthapattiyā, alīnacitto akusītavutti, daḷhanikkamo thāmabal'ūpapanno, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

74755.grammar: nt, act, from na avasīdati, neg, trans (+acc)
74755.meaning1: not getting disheartened; not becoming discouraged

74757.meaning1: with strong energy; with steady effort
74757.commentary: (NIDD2) daḷhanikkamo thāmabal'ūpapanno'ti so paccekasambuddho daḷhasamādāno ahosi kusalesu dhammesu avaṭṭhitasamādāno kāyasucarite vacīsucarite manosucarite dānasaṃvibhāge sīlasamādāne uposath'upavāse matteyyatāya petteyyatāya sāmaññatāya brahmaññatāya kulejeṭṭh'āpacāyitāya aññatar'aññataresu adhikusalesu dhammesū'ti, daḷhanikkamo. (SNPa) daḷhanikkamo'ti etena kāmaṃ taco ca nhāru cā'ti evaṃ pavattaṃ padahanavīriyaṃ dasseti, yaṃ taṃ anupubbasikkh'ādīsu padahanto kāyena c'eva paramasaccaṃ sacchikaroti, paññāya ca naṃ ativijjha passatī'ti vuccati. atha vā etena maggasampayuttavīriyaṃ dasseti. tañ'hi daḷhañ'ca bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gatattā, nikkamo ca sabbaso paṭipakkhā nikkhantattā, tasmā taṃsamaṅgīpuggalo'pi daḷho nikkamo assā'ti daḷhanikkamo'ti vuccati.

examples.text: āraddhavīriyo param'atthapattiyā, alīnacitto akusītavutti, daḷhanikkamo thāmabal'ūpapanno, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

74758.meaning1: continuously undertaking; persistently taking upon oneself; practicing consistently

74759.meaning1: endowed with endurance and power; having stamina and strength
74759.commentary: (NIDD2) thāmabal'ūpapanno'ti so paccekasambuddho thāmena ca balena ca vīriyena ca parakkamena ca paññāya ca upeto hoti samupeto upāgato samupāgato upapanno samupapanno samannāgato'ti, daḷhanikkamo thāmabal'ūpapanno, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo. (SNPa) thāmabal'ūpapanno'ti maggakkhaṇe kāyathāmena ñāṇabalena ca upapanno, atha vā thāmabhūtena balena upapanno'ti thāmabal'ūpapanno, thirañāṇabal'ūpapanno'ti vuttaṃ hoti. etena tassa vīriyassa vipassanāñāṇasampayogaṃ dīpento yoniso padahanabhāvaṃ sādheti.

examples.text: āraddhavīriyo param'atthapattiyā, alīnacitto akusītavutti, daḷhanikkamo thāmabal'ūpapanno, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

74760.meaning1: not neglecting meditation; not forgetting jhāna
74760.commentary: (NIDD2) jhānam'ariñcamāno'ti so paccekasambuddho dvīhi kāraṇehi jhānaṃ na riñcati, anuppannassa vā paṭhamassa jhānassa uppādāya yutto payutto saṃyutto āyutto samāyutto, anuppannassa vā dutiyassa jhānassa… anuppannassa vā tatiyassa jhānassa… anuppannassa vā catutthassa jhānassa uppādāya yutto payutto saṃyutto āyutto samāyutto'ti, evam'pi jhānaṃ na riñcati.

examples.text: paṭisallānaṃ jhānam'ariñcamāno, dhammesu niccaṃ anudhammacārī, ādīnavaṃ sammasitā bhavesu, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
sīho yathā dāṭhabalī pasayha, rājā migānaṃ abhibhuyya cārī, sevetha pantāni sen'āsanāni, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
mettaṃ upekkhaṃ karuṇaṃ vimuttiṃ, āsevamāno muditañ'ca kāle, sabbena lokena avirujjhamāno, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

74763.commentary: (NIDD2) bhajanti sevanti ca kāraṇ'atthā'ti att'atthakāraṇā par'atthakāraṇā ubhay'atthakāraṇā diṭṭhadhammik'atthakāraṇā samparāyik'atthakāraṇā param'atthakāraṇā bhajanti sambhajanti sevanti nisevanti saṃsevanti paṭisevantīti, bhajanti sevanti ca kāraṇ'atthā. (SNPa) kāraṇaṃ attho etesan'ti kāraṇ'atthā, bhajanāya sevanāya ca n'āññaṃ kāraṇam'atthi, attho eva nesaṃ kāraṇaṃ, atthahetu sevantī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: bhajanti sevanti ca kāraṇ'atthā, nikkāraṇā dullabhā ajja mittā, att'aṭṭhapaññā asucī manussā, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

74764.meaning1: self-centred; looking out only for one's own benefit; serving only oneself
74764.meaningLit: with self benefit wisdom; (comm) wisdom standing in oneself
74764.commentary: (SNPa) attani ṭhitā etesaṃ paññā, attānaṃ'y'eva olokenti, na aññan'ti att'aṭṭhapaññā. diṭṭh'atthapaññā'ti ayam'pi kira porāṇapāṭho, sampati diṭṭhi'y'eva atthe etesaṃ paññā, āyatiṃ na pekkhantī'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (APAa) att'aṭṭhapaññā'ti attani ṭhitā etesaṃ paññā. attānam'eva oloketi, na aññanti attho. att'atthapaññā'ti'pi pāṭho, tassa attano attham'eva oloketi, na paratthan'ti attho. diṭṭh'atthapaññā'ti ayam'pi kira porāṇapāṭho, tassa sampati diṭṭhe'y'eva atthe etesaṃ paññā, na āyatin'ti attho.
74764.notes: The commentary takes it as atta + ṭha + pañña. Also note the two variants in the commentary

examples.text: bhajanti sevanti ca kāraṇ'atthā, nikkāraṇā dullabhā ajja mittā, att'aṭṭhapaññā asucī manussā, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

74765.meaning1: without motive; with no ulterior motive
74765.commentary: (NIDD2) nikkāraṇā dullabhā ajja mittā'ti ime dve mittā akāraṇā nikkāraṇā ahetū appaccayā dullabhā dulladdhā sudulladdhā'ti, nikkāraṇā dullabhā ajja mittā. (SNPa) nikkāraṇā dullabhā ajja mittā'ti ito kiñci lacchāmā'ti evaṃ attapaṭilābhakāraṇena nikkāraṇā

examples.text: bhajanti sevanti ca kāraṇ'atthā, nikkāraṇā dullabhā ajja mittā, att'aṭṭhapaññā asucī manussā, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

74766.meaning1: ancient variant reading; old textual variant

examples.text: pucchāmi muniṃ pahūtapaññaṃ, buddhaṃ dhammassāmiṃ vītataṇhaṃ, dvipad'uttamaṃ sārathīnaṃ pavaraṃ, kati loke samaṇā tadiṅgha brūhi.

74768.meaning1: who shows the way; who teaches the path
74768.commentary: (SNPa) taṃ kaṅkhachidaṃ muniṃ anejan'ti taṃ evarūpaṃ catusaccapaṭivedhena attano, desanāya ca paresaṃ kaṅkhacchedanena kaṅkhacchidaṃ, moneyyasamannāgamena muniṃ, ejāsaṅkhātāya taṇhāya abhāvato anejaṃ dutiyaṃ bhikkhunam'āhu maggadesin'ti.

examples.text: paramaṃ paraman'ti yo'dha ñatvā, akkhāti vibhajate idh'eva dhammaṃ, taṃ kaṅkhachidaṃ muniṃ anejaṃ, dutiyaṃ bhikkhunam'āhu maggadesiṃ.

74769.meaning1: who shows; who points out; who guides
74769.commentary: (SNPa) taṃ kaṅkhachidaṃ muniṃ anejan'ti taṃ evarūpaṃ catusaccapaṭivedhena attano, desanāya ca paresaṃ kaṅkhacchedanena kaṅkhacchidaṃ, moneyyasamannāgamena muniṃ, ejāsaṅkhātāya taṇhāya abhāvato anejaṃ dutiyaṃ bhikkhunam'āhu maggadesin'ti.

examples.text: paramaṃ paraman'ti yo'dha ñatvā, akkhāti vibhajate idh'eva dhammaṃ, taṃ kaṅkhachidaṃ muniṃ anejaṃ, dutiyaṃ bhikkhunam'āhu maggadesiṃ.

74770.meaning1: fact of being a part; fact of being a constituent

74771.meaning1: who lives on the path; who is on the road

examples.text: yo dhammapade sudesite, magge jīvati saññato satīmā, anavajjapadāni sevamāno, tatiyaṃ bhikkhunam'āhu maggajīviṃ.

74773.meaning1: not ended; not terminated; not concluded; not finished

74774.meaning1: fact of having something to be done; fact of having obligations; fact of having work to do

74775.meaning1: blameless state; irreproachable path; (comm) thirty seven factors pertaining to awakening
74775.commentary: (SNPa) aṇumattassā'pi vajjassa abhāvato anavajjattā, koṭṭhāsabhāvena ca padattā sattatiṃsa-bodhipakkhiyadhamma-saṅkhātāni anavajjapadāni bhaṅgañāṇato pabhuti bhāvanāsevanāya sevamāno taṃ bhikkhunaṃ tatiyaṃ maggajīvin'ti āhū'ti.

examples.text: yo dhammapade sudesite, magge jīvati saññato satīmā, anavajjapadāni sevamāno, tatiyaṃ bhikkhunam'āhu maggajīviṃ.

74776.grammar: nt, abstr, from na avajja, neg
74776.meaning1: fact of being irreproachable; faultlessness; blamelessness; innocence
74776.construction:
na > an + ava + √vad + ya + tta
anavajja + tta

examples.text: ete ca paṭivijjhi yo gahaṭṭho, sutavā ariyasāvako sapañño, sabbe n'etādisā'ti ñatvā, iti disvā na hāpeti tassa saddhā, kathaṃ hi duṭṭhena asampaduṭṭhaṃ, suddhaṃ asuddhena samaṃ kareyyā'ti.

74778.construction: na > a + vi > vy > by + ā + √miss + a

74779.construction: na > a + vi > vy > by + ā + √miss + a
74779.synonym: aneḷaka, amissa, amissī, amissīkata, asambhinnaka, asecanaka, suddhika

74780.grammar: fem, abstr, from na byāmissa, neg
74780.meaning1: fact of being unmixed; fact of being unmingled; fact of being unadulterated
74780.construction:
na > a + vi > vy > by + ā + √miss + a + tā
abyāmissa + tā

74782.meaning1: with vast wealth; with abundant resources

examples.text: pahūtavitto puriso, sahirañño sabhojano, eko bhuñjati sādūni, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.

74783.meaning1: despises; scorns; looks down (on); has contempt (for); is condescending (to)
74783.commentary: (SNPa) saññātiṃ atimaññetī'ti attano ñātim'pi jātiyā atimaññati sakyā viya viṭaṭūbhaṃ. dhanenā'pi ca kapaṇo ayaṃ daliddo'ti atimaññati, sāmīcimattam'pi na karoti, tassa te ñātayo parābhavam'eva icchanti.

examples.text: jātitthaddho dhanatthaddho, gottatthaddho ca yo naro, saññātiṃ atimaññeti, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.

74784.meaning1: which makes one an outcast; done by a low-caste person

examples.text: na khv'āhaṃ, bho gotama, jānāmi vasalaṃ vā vasalakaraṇe vā dhamme, sādhu me bhavaṃ gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetu, yath'āhaṃ jāneyyaṃ vasalaṃ vā vasalakaraṇe vā dhamme'ti.

74785.commentary: (SNPa) gāmāni nigamāni cā'ti ettha ca-saddena nagarānī'ti'pi vattabbaṃ.

examples.text: yo hanti parirundhati, gāmāni nigamāni ca, niggāhako samaññāto, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.

74786.commentary: (SNPa) niggāhako samaññāto'ti iminā hanana-parirundhanena gāma-nigama-nagara-ghātako'ti loke vidito.

examples.text: yo hanti parirundhati, gāmāni nigamāni ca, nigghātako samaññāto, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.

74787.meaning1: desire for some small thing; wanting some trifle

examples.text: yo ve kiñcikkhakamyatā, panthasmiṃ vajantaṃ janaṃ, hantvā kiñcikkham'ādeti, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.

74788.meaning1: teaches what is not beneficial; gives bad advice

examples.text: yo atthaṃ pucchito santo, anattham'anusāsati, paṭicchannena manteti, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.
yo ve parakulaṃ gantvā, bhutvāna sucibhojanaṃ, āgataṃ nappaṭipūjeti, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.

74790.commentary: (SNPa) nijigīsāno'ti nijigīsamāno maggamāno, taṃ vañcetvā yaṃkiñci gahetvā palāyitu'kāmo'ti adhippāyo.
74790.notes: Kaccāyana (474, 535) takes the root as √har, which corresponds with the Sanskrit desiderative jihīrṣati (see MW hṛ). But a more likely candidate is √ji, which corresponds with the Sanskrit desiderative jigīṣati (see MW ji).

examples.text: asataṃ yo'dha pabrūti, mohena paliguṇṭhito, kiñcikkhaṃ nijigīsāno, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.

74791.meaning1: the lowest of the low; the worst of the worst
74791.commentary: (SNPa) eso kho vasal'ādhamo'ti. ettha kho'ti avadhāraṇattho, tena eso eva vasal'ādhamo. vasalānaṃ hīno sabbapacchimako'ti avadhāreti. kasmā? visiṭṭhavatthumhi theyyadhammavassanato, yāva taṃ paṭiññaṃ na vissajjeti, tāva avigatavasalakaraṇadhammato cā'ti.

examples.text: yo ve anarahaṃ santo, arahaṃ paṭijānāti, coro sabrahmake loke, eso kho vasal'ādhamo.

74792.meaning1: according to this (example) of mine; as per this (illustration) of mine
74792.commentary: (SNPa) tadaminā'pi jānātha, yathā me'daṃ nidassanaṃ, taṃ iminā'pi pakārena jānātha, yena me pakārena yena sāmaññena idaṃ nidassanan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: tadaminā'pi jānātha, yathāme'daṃ nidassanaṃ, caṇḍālaputto sopāko, mātaṅgo iti vissuto.

74793.meaning1: son of an outcaste; child of the lowest caste

examples.text: tadaminā'pi jānātha, yathāme'daṃ nidassanaṃ, caṇḍālaputto sopāko, mātaṅgo iti vissuto.

74794.meaning1: attained the highest fame; gained the ultimate prestige
74794.commentary: (SNPa) so'ti purimapadena sambandhitvā so mātaṅgo yasaṃ paramaṃ patto, abbhutaṃ uttamaṃ ativisiṭṭhaṃ yasaṃ kittiṃ pasaṃsaṃ patto.

examples.text: so yasapparamappatto, mātaṅgo yaṃ sudullabhaṃ, āgacchuṃ tass'upaṭṭhānaṃ, khattiyā brāhmaṇā bahū.

74795.meaning1: family of a Brahman teacher; household of Vedic reciter
74795.commentary: (SNPa) ajjhāyakakule jātā'ti mantajjhāyake brāhmaṇakule jātā. ajjhāyakākuḷe jātā'ti'pi pāṭho. mantānaṃ ajjhāyake anupakuṭṭhe ca brāhmaṇakule jātā'ti attho.

examples.text: ajjhāyakakule jātā, brāhmaṇā mantabandhavā, te ca pāpesu kammesu, abhiṇham'upadissare.

74796.grammar: fem, abl sg of duggati, irreg form of duggatiyā
74796.meaning1: from a state of misery; from a bad destination; from hell
74796.construction:
dur + √gam + ti + yā
duggati + yā > duggaccā
74796.commentary: (SNPa) na ne jāti nivāreti, duggatyā garahāya vā'ti sā tathā ukkaṭṭhā'pi yaṃ tvaṃ sārato paccesi, jāti ete pāpakammesu padissante brāhmaṇe samparāye ca duggatī'ti ettha vuttappakārāya duggatiyā vā, diṭṭh'eva dhamme gārayhā'ti ettha vuttappakārāya garahāya vā na nivāreti.

examples.text: diṭṭh'eva dhamme gārayhā, samparāye ca duggati, na ne jāti nivāreti, duggaccā garahāya vā.
ajja pannaraso uposatho, dibyā ratti upaṭṭhitā, anomanāmaṃ satthāraṃ, handa passāma gotamaṃ.
alaṅ'karotha maṃ khippaṃ, sakhiyo c'ālaṅ'karontu me, suve pannaraso dibyo, gacchaṃ issarasantike.

74798.meaning1: well orientated; well disposed; correctly inclined

examples.text: kacci mano supaṇihito, sabbabhūtesu tādino, kacci iṭṭhe aniṭṭhe ca, saṅkappassa vasīkatā.

74799.commentary: (SNPa) dutiyācariyo majjhimadese sātapabbate sātāgiro'ti nāmena. te'pi nesaṃ parivārā bhikkhū tesaṃ'y'eva anuvattitvā sagge nibbattitum'asakkontā tesaṃ parivārā yakkhā'va hutvā nibbattiṃsu. tesaṃ pana paccayadāyakā gahaṭṭhā devaloke nibbatiṃsu. hemavatasātāgirā aṭṭhavīsati-yakkha-senāpatīnam'abbhantarā mah'ānubhāvā yakkharājāno ahesuṃ.

examples.text: musā ca so na bhaṇati, (iti sātāgiro yakkho) atho na khīṇabyappatho, atho vebhūtiyaṃ n'āha, mantā atthaṃ ca bhāsati.
